name: Holbox
tagline: Car-free island of whale sharks and flamingos
summary: Holbox is a sandy, car-free island off the Yucatán with sand streets and colourful murals. Swim with whale sharks from June to September, watch flamingos at Punta Mosquito, see glowing bioluminescence at night and walk the sandbars at sunset.
seasonNote: Whale sharks June to September; dry season December to April.
arrival: Bus or shuttle to Chiquilá (2.5 hours from Cancún), then a 25-minute ferry.
cashTip: Carry pesos for markets, taxis and small places; cards work in larger restaurants. Tip 10 to 15 percent.
